title: Multiplicative Chow-Künneth decomposition and homology splitting of configuration spaces

predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: Many works cited in the text are absent from the reference list, e.g. [Voi14], [SV16], [FLV21b], [Cer83], [GS95], [Tot96], [Pet20], [Pet17], [DJ20], [Ivo16], [Tub23], [Sai90], [Pet15], [Pet16], [Pet13], [Wat18], [Ver61], [Zuc79], [Sch95], [CL22], [Tav18], [GP03], [PT14], [Tom24]. A careful reviewer would require a complete bibliography.

The text explicitly says Table 1 compiles all cohomology groups H^*(M2,Vλ) for |λ|≤12, and Section 4.1 refers to Table 1 for properties of M_{2,n} cohomology, but no Table 1 is present in the paper text. Only Tables 2, 3, and 4 appear.

The paper states H^1(A_{1,1},V_{a,b})(−1) ≅ S_{a-b+2}(-b) ⊕ Q(-1-a). But by Proposition 3.5, H^1(A_{1,1},V_{a,b}) ≅ S_{a-b+2}(-b) ⊕ Q(-1-a), so after tensoring with Q(-1) the twists should be S_{a-b+2}(-b-1) ⊕ Q(-2-a). Later text (e.g. 3.10, 3.12) uses the correct shifts such as Q(-2-a) and S_{12}(-2), so this is an internal twist inconsistency.

hλ is defined as ∑_i [H^i(H_{∞,n},Q)⊗_{S_n} σλ] t^i, which is a sum of actual cohomology classes and therefore must have nonnegative coefficients in K0(MHS). However, Table 3 contains entries such as h_(2)=1−Lt+(L^2+L)t^2−(L^3+L^2)t^3+... with negative coefficients, and Table 4 numerators likewise expand to series with negative coefficients under the stated denominator. This is impossible for the stated definition; either the definition needs an alternating sign or the tables are not the quantities defined.

The formula for H^2(A_2,Vλ) is stated for even λ and gives 0 unless a=b≡0 mod 2 with s_{a+b+4}>0. If λ=0 is included, this would imply H^2(A_2,Q)=0. But A_2 is a smooth quasi-projective Siegel modular threefold and has nonzero H^2 (e.g. the Kähler class of the Hodge line bundle). Thus the formula is false for the trivial local system unless λ≠0 is explicitly assumed.

The text says [CLP23, Lemma 7.3] states that H^{15}(M_{2,12},Q) is generated by cycles pushed forward from the boundary. But boundary pushforwards live in the compactification \bar M_{2,12}; they restrict to zero on the open moduli space M_{2,12}. The lemma likely concerns H^{15}(\bar M_{2,12},Q), so the citation appears to misquote the result or misidentify the space.
